digest.component_or_area: ticket create/edit with plan-review admission guard
propositions: The description cap must read from config key verify.max_ticket_description_chars (default 8000) and be shared by the plan-review guard, completion precheck, and save-time warning (single source of truth).

When a ticket is created or edited with description exceeding the configured cap AND the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a save-time warning must be displayed stating the actual length, the cap, and that plan review will refuse admission until shortened.
The warning must be emitted at save time (after the write is committed) across all surfaces: CLI stderr, library logger, and MCP result field; the warning must never block or alter the write.
No warning is emitted when the gate is disabled, when description is within cap, or for exempt ticket types; the save always succeeds.

The warning implementation must reuse the same gate-applicability probe (_plan_review_gate_applies) that the claim path uses, ensuring consistency between the warning promise and the actual gate behavior.
